title: Neural Progenitor Expansion Protocol
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x88frzw

steps.title: Prepare Neural Rosette Clusters
steps.instruction: Prepare the neural rosette clusters for plating using a pre-coated PLO-laminin plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate laminin from 2-3 wells of the pre-coated PLO-laminin plate.
Remove supernatant from the 15 mL conical tube containing 2 wells of neural rosette clusters.
Add an appropriate amount of neural induction media (NIM) to achieve a final volume of 2 mL per well.
Pipet clusters up and down to break them into 1/4 or 1/5 the size of the original rosette cluster.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate Clusters
steps.instruction: Seed the clusters and allow them to adhere.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of neural rosette cluster suspension to each well.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidified chamber for 24 hours.

steps.title: Maintain Adherent Cells
steps.instruction: Maintain the cells until they reach the required confluency.

substeps.instruction: Examine adherent cells under a microscope.
Aspirate medium and replace with 2 mL of fresh neural induction medium daily for 3-5 days, or until cells reach ~80% confluency.

steps.title: Prepare Complete Media
steps.instruction: Prepare 12 mL of Complete Media to inhibit trypsin activity.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of FBS to 10 mL of DMEM/F12 to create 12 mL of DMEM/F12 supplemented with 10% FBS.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Detach the cells from the plate using trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Remove medium and rinse cells with 1 mL/well of DMEM/F12.
Add 1 mL/well of 0.05% trypsin and incubate at 37 °C for 3 minutes.
Inhibit trypsin activity by adding 4 mL of DMEM/F12 supplemented with 10% FBS to each well.

steps.title: Collect and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the trypsinized cells and concentrate them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL DMEM/F12 to collect cells and transfer them to a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 1 mL Complete Media to the 15 mL conical tube to minimize bubbles and increase cell yield.
Centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend and Passage Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet and plate them onto new coated plates.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant and resuspend in 12 mL of NIM.
Pipet at least 3 times to break up large clumps (small clumps and single cells are acceptable).
Passage cells to pre-coated PLO-lamin plates by adding 2 mL/well for a total of 6 wells.

steps.title: Expand Neural Progenitor Cells
steps.instruction: Feed and maintain the NPCs until they reach high confluency.

substeps.instruction: Feed with 2 mL of fresh NIM daily until cells reach 85-95% confluency.
Maintain NPCs by passaging at a 1:3 dilution (cells typically become confluent after 2-4 days at this dilution).
If growth slows, passage and replate without dilution.
